This notice applies to 1/car1-stock1.rgb, 2/car1-stock1.rgb, logo.rgb, and all
XCF/SVG files under artwork/. Keep the source artwork and this attribution
when distributing a modified example, and identify your changes.

The liveries derive from Tutorial B's layered source, supplied in this tutorial,
which derives from the stock-car artwork in the TORCS source tree:
data/cars/models/car1-stock1/car1-stock1.xcf (see its adjacent readme.txt).
Upstream source:
https://sourceforge.net/p/torcs/code/ci/HEAD/tree/torcs/torcs/data/cars/models/car1-stock1/

Tutorial C changes: separate red and teal paint, numbers 81 and 82, Tutorial C
wing lettering, and a common C pit sign with red/teal accents. Each car's layered
XCF and editable decal SVG are included. Body details, glass and the hidden UV
guide are retained. The runtime images are real SGI files, not renamed PNGs.

C++ source, build/configuration files and maintenance scripts use their separate
GPL-2.0-or-later license. Tutorial text and teaching diagrams use GNU FDL 1.2+.
